name: Three-phase AC source
summary: A three-phase AC source identifies a documented three-phase supply boundary.
description: A three-phase AC source identifies a documented three-phase supply boundary. Its nominal voltage, phase sequence and neutral availability must be stated where the design relies on them.
readingNotes: Locate the source boundary before interpreting upstream ownership or available fault data.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: Three-phase source designation does not establish an accessible neutral conductor.
